source: A plural key is an object with the CLDR forms {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4} and {5}. A usage of the key counts as a usage of each form.
text: 复数 key 是一个对象，包含 CLDR 形式 {0}、{1}、{2}、{3}、{4} 和 {5}。对该 key 的一处引用会被视为对每种形式的引用。
